title: Mark K NDE 4676
content: I was stationed aboard the USS Prairie in the Philippines, we had a ship's party on Grande Island there, I was scuba diving for coral, I was almost bitten by a sixteen foot long dark grey shark, I managed to get to shore unharmed I thought, I did not feel the toxic coral embed in the bottom of my foot. I showed my shipmates the shadow of the shark just off shore twenty-five feet away, but was unable to utter a word due to sheer terror of almost being caught and eaten. After a half hour or so, my friends and I were going back to the ship by shuttle boat. I passed out and fell into the bottom of the boat face down. My friend Billy got me onto the ship, into the medical lab, where after some efforts there I was pronounced dead on the Navy ship. When I sat up twenty-nine hours later, there was a doctor in a lab coat nine feet from me, in shock from fear, urinating inside his white gown. I wondered what I was looking at, and asked myself in my head, why was this doctor paralyzed with fear in his eyes looking at me and urinating on himself. At that point, I told him he was urinating on himself, and he asked in return, have you looked at yourself lately. As I rolled my head to the left to view my arm at my side, I realized I was in a Morgue with a toe tag on my left big toe, with a white sheet that was covering all but my face, due to arising. What I saw was my dark-purple dehydrated arm with orange-tinged veins. I felt better than I had in years, full of energy, as if I just woke up Sunday morning without a care in the world. The doctor informed me of the coral in my foot, and that I was deceased for twenty-nine hours, and proceeded to show me the brainwave chart, stretched out across the floor, with no activity on the roll. He then stopped and asked me was there anything I remembered, was there life after death. He was so excited at just asking the question, so I answered him with the most honest recollection of the experience I could. I was in a grey cloud room, with an elderly man and woman. They were about sixty-eight years old and sitting on a grey bench. I could not see where the corners in the room were, and it bothered me. As the cloud shaped door opened, and a being which I knew was there, but couldn't see persuaded me by calling my name, through the door. I could not see anything but light past the exit of the door until I stepped onto a beach, and I was there, so were hundreds of fully clothed robed people also, but none would look at me in the eye, for as far as I could see down the beach. I looked down to see my body as to find out why they would not acknowledge me with a glance, when I realized I had no body to look at, no torso, legs or feet, I was looking straight down at the sand. I raised my arms to view them, and no arms were seen by me. It did not alarm me in any way. I just felt energy and I liked it. I then saw a man in an earthen, light and dark brown dual cloth robe. He was looking me in the eye from two hundred yards down the beach. As I noticed there was a colossal eggshell textured ROOF over the sun and the ocean, and all of the planet I felt I was on, but I felt it was not earth as I know my planet. I kept my attention on the man as he walked all the way to me. When we were face to face, I was focused on his radiant light blue eyes. I realized he looked like the Caucasian picture of Jesus that I had seen all my life in the churches I had attended. I was feeling absolutely gleeful as he told me in a vary compassionate calm voice, 'You are not supposed to be here yet.' That is when I sat up off the slab in the ship's morgue as the doctor almost died of sheer fright, since I had died the day before. I now have an extra ESP sense, and have premonitions a lot, sometimes I can see in a different light spectrum with my eyes where even trees emit a light and so does the earth. I no longer fear death, but sometimes await it an in a longing for the peace I felt, during my experience. I also sense evil people before they make any contact with me. I know people before I meet them. Upon meeting them, I say what they are saying as they speak the words, and it shocks them. I meet people in dreams, and then in real life weeks later, and every time it was in an effort to save a third party from harm. I cannot explain it all, but it was my wake up call. I do know the nine hundred people on my ship never quite looked at me the same again. As they were all advised of my death, and the next week I was back to work. I did drink four gallons of water. When I woke that day, I was purple, orange, and dehydrated. I did not urinate for four days after drinking the water. I found it odd that I knew I needed exactly four gallons of water in my body - no less, and no more. It was if my consciousness already knew what to ask for. I have died several other times, motorcycling hit by drunk hit and runner in Auburn, Washington. 1985, the doctor was my surgeon. Cliff diving in Spokane, Washington, 1978. Heart attack Vancouver, Washington 2009. And not forgetting falling off a ninety-foot cliff at Crystal Mountain, Snoqualmie Pass, Washington. When I was a teen, my ski Emergency Responder on the mountain that day, and was also my math teacher at Hilltop Elementary School in Seattle, Washington. All are documented, as was my being beaten to death by a Colorado Cop with a Billy club a block from my father's porch in Broomfield, Colorado 1986. I guess I'm still not supposed to be there - 'Yet'.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: He looked like the Caucasian picture of Jesus the experiencer had seen in churches; radiant light blue eyes; wore an earthen light/dark brown dual cloth robe; said, 'You are not supposed to be here yet.'
arrival.other_being_detail: A being the experiencer knew was there but could not see persuaded him by calling his name through a cloud-shaped door.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'grey cloud room' with a grey bench and a cloud-shaped door; later a beach with hundreds of robed people; an 'eggshell textured ROOF' over the sun, ocean, and the whole planet; felt it was not Earth.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Scuba diving injury: toxic coral embedded in foot; later passed out on shuttle boat; pronounced dead aboard Navy ship.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Attended churches; familiar with common church depiction of Jesus.
person_demographics.occupation: U.S. Navy servicemember stationed aboard USS Prairie

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Grey cloud room with elderly man and woman; cloud-shaped door; beach with hundreds of robed people; eggshell-textured roof over sun/ocean/planet; encounter with Jesus-like figure who said, 'You are not supposed to be here yet.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No explicit OBE/tunnel described; began in a cloud room, then through a door into light and onto a beach; boundary message triggered immediate return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Colossal eggshell-textured 'ROOF' over the sun, ocean, and entire planet; hundreds of robed people who would not look at him; perception of having no body and looking straight down at sand; return coincided with sitting up in morgue after being deceased for 29 hours; doctor urinated from shock.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'You are not supposed to be here yet.'
